verdict.rationale: Unit documents a deprecation commitment: deprecated endpoints get a minimum six-month notice before retirement, as do all breaking changes, except for urgent security or compliance changes. The same source says the API uses unversioned paths with no URL- or header-based version scheme, so the 'versioned APIs' half of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: an explicit API versioning scheme, version pinning or migration guidance, a changelog of deprecations, and independent corroboration that the notice period is honored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: may be retired at a later point in time - subject to a minimum of a six month notice period, like all breaking changes on Unit, unless they follow an urgent security or compliance change.
